scope: Global/multinational public marine observation sources and major discovery/aggregation systems

sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; pressure; trajectories
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to ~2000 m typical
sources.Location Metadata: Profile latitude/longitude; float trajectory; deployment position
sources.Time Metadata: Profile/cycle time; deployment time; file update time
sources.Depth Metadata: Pressure per sample; profile max depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: WMO float ID; DAC; institution; profiler type; data mode; sensor/technical metadata
sources.QC / Data Mode: Real-time QC + delayed-mode scientific QC; per-variable QC/error
sources.Native Search / Filters: Location; time; parameter; depth; data mode; DAC; deployment year; platform attributes via selection tools
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: None for GDAC; selection tools may have normal web use
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: GDAC HTTP/FTP/rsync; US/Euro-Argo selection tools
sources.App Integration Notes: Use profile index files to build a very efficient existence index before touching NetCDF.

sources.Spatial Coverage: Global, sparse relative to Core Argo
sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; pressure
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: To ~4000-6000 m depending float type
sources.Depth Metadata: Pressure per sample to abyssal depths
sources.Other Key Metadata: Float model; mission; WMO ID; DAC; sensor metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Location; time; parameter; depth; platform type through Argo selection/index files
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Same GDAC/selection workflow as Core Argo
sources.App Integration Notes: Index as a mission/platform subtype of Argo; do not create duplicate observations if also ingesting all Argo profiles.

sources.Spatial Coverage: Global, heterogeneous; strong Southern Ocean coverage
sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; oxygen; nitrate; pH; chlorophyll fluorescence; backscatter; irradiance; other BGC parameters
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to ~2000 m typical
sources.Other Key Metadata: WMO float ID; parameter list; data mode per parameter; calibration metadata
sources.QC / Data Mode: RT + delayed-mode QC; variable-specific adjusted values/errors
sources.Native Search / Filters: Region; time; measured parameter; depth; QC/data mode using S-prof/b-prof indexes or Euro-Argo selection
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: GDAC S-prof/b-prof index files or selection tools
sources.App Integration Notes: For app discovery, ingest S-prof and bio-profile index files because they explicitly list which BGC parameters exist.

sources.Observations / Variables: Position; surface currents; SST; often SLP; selected extra sensors
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface / drogue depth metadata
sources.Other Key Metadata: Drifter ID; deployment; drogue status; manufacturer/specifications; barometer metadata
sources.QC / Data Mode: Real-time plus QC database updated every few months
sources.Native Search / Filters: Specific time; location; drifter ID through web tools; bulk hourly/QC files
sources.Download Formats: CSV/ASCII; bulk files; other archive formats
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Real-time search; interpolated search; entire hourly dataset; delayed-mode QC bulk download
sources.App Integration Notes: Drogue status is essential metadata for interpreting current velocity.

sources.Spatial Coverage: Primarily U.S. waters plus partner stations distributed more broadly
sources.Observations / Variables: Wind; pressure; air temperature; humidity/dew point; SST; wave height/period/direction; spectra; currents; oceanographic variables; tide; solar radiation
sources.Platform Types: Moored buoys; drifting buoys; C-MAN/coastal stations; partner platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface; sensor-specific subsurface; ADCP profiles where present
sources.Location Metadata: Station table: lat/lon, owner, station metadata; station pages
sources.Depth Metadata: Sensor height/depth; station water depth; ADCP/ocean data may be depth resolved
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station ID/WMO ID; owner; station type; sensor heights; station configuration
sources.QC / Data Mode: Automated QC for real time; post-processed historical archive
sources.Native Search / Filters: Native search is mainly station-first; station table can be spatially indexed by your app
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Realtime files: /data/realtime2/{station}.{type}; historical directories by data type/year; DODS for NetCDF
sources.App Integration Notes: Best strategy: ingest station_table.txt as metadata, then index per-station file availability by datatype/year.

sources.Observations / Variables: Bottom pressure-derived water-column height; event-mode tsunami observations; station metadata
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Seafloor/bottom pressure; station water depth
sources.Time Metadata: Timestamp; deployment start; query date range
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station ID; threshold; deployment; owner
sources.Native Search / Filters: Station + start/end date query
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Dynamic URL query for station/start/end; historical DART directory
sources.App Integration Notes: Keep DART separate from normal surface buoy observations because its vertical reference is the seafloor.

sources.Role: Tropical moored observation network + ERDDAP archive
sources.Repository / Network Period: Combined PMEL archive includes records from late 1970s-present; variable/station dependent
sources.Observations / Variables: Ocean temperature; salinity; currents; SST; wind; SLP; air T/RH; shortwave/longwave radiation; heat fluxes; derived thermocline metrics
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface and multiple subsurface sensor depths
sources.Time Metadata: High-frequency source observations; daily products; time per record
sources.Depth Metadata: Depth coordinate in subsurface products; sensor depth metadata
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station; WMO platform code; source array; quality flags
sources.QC / Data Mode: PMEL/array QC; ERDDAP exposes quality variables
sources.Native Search / Filters: ERDDAP constraints on lon/lat/time/station/depth/variable depending dataset
sources.Download Formats: NetCDF; CSV; JSON and other ERDDAP outputs
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use PMEL ERDDAP search/catalog; select dataset then constrain coordinates/time/depth
sources.App Integration Notes: For the app, index ERDDAP dataset metadata first, then materialize observation-level existence only for the variables users care about.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Site/deployment dependent; multi-decadal at some sites
sources.Observations / Variables: T/S; currents; meteorology; oxygen; carbon/BGC; radiation; sediments and site-specific sensors
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to full mooring instrument depth; sometimes bottom
sources.Other Key Metadata: Site code; deployment; instrument; method; data mode; provenance
sources.QC / Data Mode: Minimal QC for RT/recovered; best available version; OceanSITES QC flags
sources.Native Search / Filters: Catalog/file-based; your app should harvest file metadata and coordinates/time/depth extents
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Browse OceanSITES GDAC/catalog; download compliant NetCDF
sources.App Integration Notes: Excellent metadata conventions for discovery; use file-level extents plus variable inventory.

sources.Observations / Variables: Sea level / water level; raw real-time station series
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface water level relative to station datum
sources.Depth Metadata: Not a water-column profile; datum/reference metadata instead of depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station ID/name; operator; status; datum/catalog links
sources.QC / Data Mode: Raw NRT; complementary QC tiers are at UHSLC/BODC/PSMSL
sources.Native Search / Filters: Station/map/web-service based spatial and time access
sources.Download Formats: Web-service outputs / tabular formats depending endpoint
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use IOC Sea Level Monitoring service/web service for direct real-time access
sources.App Integration Notes: Use this for current availability; pair with UHSLC/PSMSL for quality-controlled historical coverage.

sources.Operator: University of Hawaii Sea Level Center
sources.Observations / Variables: Hourly/daily sea level; fast-delivery and research-quality products
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Sea level relative to station datum
sources.Time Metadata: Time series; fast-mode posted within ~1-2 months; research quality annual
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station identifiers; quality tier; originator metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Station/location/time access
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use UHSLC data portal / GLOSS fast-mode and JASL links
sources.App Integration Notes: Use the quality tier as a first-class field so the app can distinguish NRT vs research-quality data.

sources.Operator: Permanent Service for Mean Sea Level
sources.Repository / Network Period: Station-dependent; some records extend to 19th century
sources.Observations / Variables: Monthly and annual mean sea level
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Sea level/datum; no depth profile
sources.Other Key Metadata: Station ID; RLR datum history; documentation
sources.Native Search / Filters: Station/location/time; typically download by station/dataset
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use PSMSL station search/download for long-term monthly/annual means
sources.App Integration Notes: Not appropriate for high-frequency event detection; ideal for historical coverage questions.

sources.Observations / Variables: CTD T/S/O2; bottle DIC; alkalinity; pH; nutrients; tracers; many BGC variables
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to seafloor / full ocean depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: Cruise expocode; station/cast; ship; chief scientist; parameter list; provenance
sources.Native Search / Filters: Cruise advanced search by lat/lon/time; ERDDAP profile search by parameters
sources.Download Formats: WHP-Exchange CSV; WOCE; NetCDF; ERDDAP outputs
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use Advanced Search/Map Search for cruises or ERDDAP for profile-level filters and download
sources.App Integration Notes: One of the best sources for full-depth 'does this parameter exist at this location/depth/time?' queries.

sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; oxygen; nutrients; chlorophyll; tracers; plankton and many other profile variables
sources.Platform Types: CTD; bottles/OSD; XBT/MBT; profiling floats; drifters; moored buoys; gliders; animal tags; surface-only and more
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to full ocean depth; searchable by deepest measurement
sources.Depth Metadata: Observed depth/pressure levels; deepest measurement searchable
sources.Other Key Metadata: Dataset/instrument type; country; ship/platform; cruise; accession; project; institute; QC flags
sources.QC / Data Mode: Uniform WOD QC; IQuOD flags/uncertainty options
sources.Native Search / Filters: Excellent native filters: bbox; date; instrument/dataset; variables; biology; deepest measurement; platform; cruise; project; institute; QC
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Email required to receive extraction link
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use WODselect to build query, choose format/depth-level/QC, submit email, then download generated files
sources.App Integration Notes: This is the closest thing to a universal historical in-situ profile existence service.

sources.Role: Global T/S profile archive + real time
sources.Repository / Network Period: 1990-present in current query interface; archive contains older accessions
sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity profiles
sources.Platform Types: CTD; XBT; Argo; ship and other profile platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Profile depths/pressures; can exceed 1000 m/full-depth depending instrument
sources.Other Key Metadata: Platform code; call sign; data type; data mode; database ID; QC history
sources.Native Search / Filters: Native filters: bbox/ocean; date; season; data mode; data type; platform/call sign
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use GTSPP Interface for spatial/time/type search; use HTTP/THREDDS for bulk or individual NetCDF
sources.App Integration Notes: Strong source for operational and best-copy T/S profile discovery; overlaps Argo/WOD.

sources.Observations / Variables: SST; air temperature; SLP; wind; humidity; waves; clouds/weather; platform metadata
sources.Platform Types: Ships; buoys; C-MAN and other surface marine platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface / near-surface only
sources.Depth Metadata: No profile depth; observation height/deck metadata may exist in attachments/fields
sources.Other Key Metadata: Platform type; ship/buoy IDs; source/deck; QC/flags; observation method fields
sources.QC / Data Mode: Extensive archive QC and source metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Bulk archive rather than rich observation API; app should ingest monthly/NRT files and create its own index
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Download NRT daily or monthly observation files from NCEI
sources.App Integration Notes: Primary source for historical surface marine meteorology; route-level sampling bias must be represented.

sources.Observations / Variables: T/S; currents; waves; sea level; BGC variables depending product/source
sources.Platform Types: Floats; drifters; moorings; ships; gliders; HF radar and other contributors
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to profile/full depth depending source
sources.Depth Metadata: Depth can be subset when dataset has vertical dimension
sources.Other Key Metadata: Platform/source identifiers; QC; data mode; variable metadata; dataset/product IDs
sources.Native Search / Filters: Excellent: variable; bbox; time; depth through Toolbox for compatible datasets
sources.Download Formats: NetCDF; Zarr; CSV; Parquet depending service/dataset
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use `copernicusmarine describe` to discover; `subset` for variable/bbox/time/depth; `get` for original files
sources.App Integration Notes: Excellent app backend because query dimensions align almost exactly with your proposed UI; deduplicate against direct sources.

sources.Spatial Coverage: Primarily U.S.-operated deployments; may include international collaborative missions
sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity/conductivity; pressure; oxygen; chlorophyll; backscatter; currents and mission-specific sensors
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to mission max depth, often hundreds to ~1000 m
sources.Other Key Metadata: Deployment ID; glider/platform; institution; trajectory; metadata preserved in deployment dataset
sources.QC / Data Mode: Provider QC + DAC validation; RT/DM datasets
sources.Native Search / Filters: ERDDAP: dataset search and tabledap constraints on lon/lat/time/depth/variables
sources.Download Formats: NetCDF; CSV; JSON and many ERDDAP formats; THREDDS/OPeNDAP
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use ERDDAP catalog/search; retrieve dataset metadata from /info/{dataset}; query data with tabledap constraints
sources.App Integration Notes: A good template for how your own app can expose trajectory/profile observations.

sources.Spatial Coverage: Global high-latitudes, especially Southern Ocean and North Pacific/Atlantic
sources.Observations / Variables: Temperature; salinity; pressure/depth; high-density T/light in TDR; submesoscale CTD in SMS
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to animal dive depth, often hundreds to >1000 m
sources.Other Key Metadata: Tag ID; deployment ID; animal/platform; owner; calibration coefficients; adjusted errors
sources.Native Search / Filters: Bulk metadata CSV can be filtered by lat/lon/date/tag/deployment before downloading NetCDF
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Download list_profiles/list_tags/list_deployments CSV; filter locally; then retrieve public NetCDF bundle
sources.App Integration Notes: Very useful because metadata CSVs are already shaped like an existence index.

sources.Observations / Variables: Position; barometric pressure; surface temperature; air temperature; hull temperature/battery and other variables in Level 1
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface/ice interface
sources.Other Key Metadata: Buoy ID; WMO; buoy type; owner; logistics; deployment metadata
sources.QC / Data Mode: Raw daily + Level 1 QC archive with position QC
sources.Native Search / Filters: Buoy ID/date API; PolarWatch ERDDAP offers additional queryability
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: API: /download?bid=... with start/end/ndays; or PolarWatch ERDDAP; bulk Level 1 archive
sources.App Integration Notes: Excellent polar metadata and simple per-buoy API.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Centralized live portal since ~2013; older pre-2012 data less centralized
sources.Observations / Variables: Position; drift; surface temperature; air temperature; atmospheric pressure; platform-specific variables
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface/ice interface
sources.Other Key Metadata: Buoy ID/type; project/owner; deployment documentation
sources.QC / Data Mode: Live data often raw; campaign/operator QC varies
sources.Native Search / Filters: Current buoy table/portal filtering; older data may require partner contact
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use IPAB data page / Meereisportal; IABP-hosted Antarctic table provides standardized current fields
sources.App Integration Notes: Represent completeness/centralization as metadata: older Antarctic holdings are fragmented.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Current/operational; dataset retention varies by node/cache
sources.Observations / Variables: Marine BUOY/SHIP/profile and other WMO observations depending published topics
sources.Platform Types: Ships; buoys; floats; stations and other WMO observing systems
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Depends on dataset; discovery metadata may state vertical extent; BUFR payload carries observation levels
sources.Location Metadata: Dataset-level spatial extent; station metadata; payload coordinates
sources.Time Metadata: Dataset temporal extent; real-time notification time; observation time in payload
sources.Other Key Metadata: WIGOS station ID; centre; topic hierarchy; discovery record; links; policy; station metadata
sources.QC / Data Mode: Provider/operational QC; BUFR flags where defined
sources.Native Search / Filters: Global Discovery Catalogue supports metadata search; broker subscriptions filter by WIS2 topic; node OGC APIs may support bbox/time
sources.Download Formats: BUFR plus provider formats; discovery metadata GeoJSON/JSON
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Core data unrestricted; recommended data may have provider access controls
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Discover dataset via WIS2 Global Discovery Catalogue; subscribe to Global Broker MQTT; follow notification link to HTTP(S) data
sources.App Integration Notes: Use WIS2 primarily for fresh operational observations, not as your only historical archive.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Historical + current platform metadata; registry spans long periods
sources.Observations / Variables: Metadata rather than measurement values
sources.Platform Types: Argo floats; drifters; moorings; ships; gliders and other GOOS platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Deployment/end/last-location metadata; sensor types may imply vertical capability
sources.Time Metadata: Deployment date; ending date; last observation date
sources.Other Key Metadata: OceanOPS platform ID; WMO/WIGOS; program; platform type/model; sensors; telecom; ship/cruise; country; agency; status
sources.Native Search / Filters: ERDDAP tabledap supports constraints on deployment location/date/platform family/type/program
sources.Download Formats: CSV; JSON; NetCDF and other ERDDAP formats; OceanOPS REST API JSON/XML
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Public ERDDAP; OceanOPS API terms apply
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use OSMC ERDDAP `OceanOPS_platform_metadata` / `oceanops_passport`, or OceanOPS REST API
sources.App Integration Notes: Critical metadata enrichment source: join observations to platform type/model/program/sensors.

sources.Observations / Variables: Surface ocean fCO2/pCO2 plus supporting T/S/pressure and cruise/platform metadata
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface / intake depth metadata where supplied
sources.Depth Metadata: Near-surface; intake depth may be metadata
sources.Other Key Metadata: Expocode; vessel/platform; investigator; dataset QC flag; region
sources.Native Search / Filters: LAS/ERDDAP can filter region/year/platform and variables
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use SOCAT ERDDAP for programmatic subsets or LAS viewer then Save As
sources.App Integration Notes: Ideal for surface carbon existence; preserve SOCAT version and QC flag.

sources.Observations / Variables: DIC; alkalinity; pH; oxygen; nutrients; salinity; temperature; tracers and carbon-related variables
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to bottom
sources.Other Key Metadata: Cruise number/expocode; station; dataset DOI; variable flags; adjustments; cruise uncertainty
sources.Native Search / Filters: ERDDAP available; bulk master/regional files can be indexed locally
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use GLODAP ERDDAP for subsets or download master/regional synthesis files
sources.App Integration Notes: Store both adjusted value and source/cruise provenance; GLODAP is a synthesis, not raw original cruise data.

sources.Observations / Variables: Rrs/radiance; absorption/scattering/backscatter; pigments/chlorophyll; CTD; nutrients; fluorescence; productivity; plankton imagery; atmospheric optics
sources.Platform Types: Ships; moorings; field campaigns; optical systems
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface and profile measurements; searchable by water depth; variable-dependent
sources.Location Metadata: File search supports coordinate box; point positions inside files
sources.Depth Metadata: Water depth min/max search; profile depths in files
sources.Other Key Metadata: Investigator; affiliation; experiment; cruise; data type; wavelengths; products; warnings
sources.Native Search / Filters: Excellent web filters: measured date; bbox; water depth; data type; products; investigator/cruise
sources.Download Formats: SeaBASS text files; ordered bundles; CSV for validation results
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: NASA Earthdata login required for download
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use File Search, select products/date/bbox/depth, then Download All/Selection
sources.App Integration Notes: One of the few archives where depth and optical product type are native search dimensions.

sources.Observations / Variables: Water-leaving radiance / remote-sensing reflectance; aerosol/atmospheric optical properties
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface optical signal; no water-column profile
sources.Other Key Metadata: Site/instrument; processing level; wavelength
sources.Native Search / Filters: Site/date/product based portal access
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use AERONET-OC station/product download tools; often accessed as validation source through SeaBASS
sources.App Integration Notes: Treat as validation observations, not a generic water-column source.

sources.Observations / Variables: Species occurrence; abundance/event data; eDNA/DNA extensions; measurements/facts including environmental values where submitted
sources.Platform Types: Surveys; samples; imagery; telemetry; many biological platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Minimum/maximum depth fields where provided; occurrence/event depth
sources.Depth Metadata: minimumDepthInMeters / maximumDepthInMeters; bathymetry field from QC pipeline
sources.Other Key Metadata: occurrenceID; eventID; taxon/AphiaID; basisOfRecord; samplingProtocol; dataset/node/institute; licenses; QC flags
sources.Native Search / Filters: Mapper/API can filter taxon/geography/time/quality; large-scale queries best from GeoParquet/AWS
sources.Download Formats: TSV/CSV; GeoParquet; Darwin Core archives; API JSON
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Small subsets: Mapper; programmatic: API/robis; large-scale app index: download GeoParquet and query locally with DuckDB
sources.App Integration Notes: For your app, local GeoParquet indexing is far better than repeatedly hitting the OBIS API.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Dataset-dependent; 2002-present portal with older contributed observations
sources.Observations / Variables: Marine mammal; seabird; sea turtle observations; telemetry; survey effort; selected in-situ context
sources.Platform Types: Ships; aircraft; telemetry tags; photo-ID/survey platforms
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Mostly surface occurrence/telemetry; dive/depth may be dataset-specific
sources.Depth Metadata: Depth not a universal core field
sources.Other Key Metadata: Dataset ID; species; count; series/device ID; effort tracks; provider; sharing policy; citations; FGDC metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Advanced Search supports spatial/temporal/species/dataset criteria; downloads reflect current map selection
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Download form + email/passcode; some datasets require provider permission
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use Advanced Search or dataset/species pages; agree to terms; download visible/subset/full data
sources.App Integration Notes: Effort tracks are crucial for absence/detection modeling; index sharing policy because not every visible record is downloadable.

sources.Operator: Marine Biological Association and partner surveys
sources.Spatial Coverage: Multi-basin; strongest North Atlantic/North Sea, with other regional programs
sources.Observations / Variables: Plankton taxonomy; abundance; ecological indicators
sources.Platform Types: Ships of opportunity towing CPR samplers
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Near-surface tow depth; method-specific
sources.Other Key Metadata: Route; sample; taxon; survey/program metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Portal/data request mechanisms; app may need dataset-level metadata ingestion rather than open API
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: May require registration/request and citation terms
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use CPR data portal/request process; obtain sample records and metadata
sources.App Integration Notes: Important long historical biological record but access is less API-native than OBIS.

sources.Observations / Variables: Physical oceanography; chemistry; biology; sediments; geology; paleo; multidisciplinary observations
sources.Platform Types: Research cruises; stations; moorings; cores; campaigns
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Dataset-dependent; often explicit depth/elevation/event metadata
sources.Depth Metadata: Depth/elevation where supplied per event/data row
sources.Other Key Metadata: DOI; event; expedition/cruise/campaign; ship; station; device; parameter; PI; license; project
sources.QC / Data Mode: Scientific QC by contributors + curated metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: Search is dataset/metadata centric; for app use metadata API/DOI metadata then download datasets
sources.Download Formats: Tab-delimited text; dataset-specific formats; ISO/DataCite/JSON-LD metadata
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Search PANGAEA; download data using DOI with `?format=textfile`; retrieve ISO/DataCite/JSON-LD metadata by content negotiation
sources.App Integration Notes: Best 'long-tail' repository for observations not captured by standardized global networks.

sources.Source: IHO Data Centre for Digital Bathymetry (DCDB)
sources.Observations / Variables: Single-beam; multibeam; crowdsourced bathymetry soundings
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Seafloor depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: Platform; provider; file UUID; survey/cruise metadata; sonar/file metadata
sources.Native Search / Filters: DCDB Viewer spatial search; CSB Data Extract API; Crowbar metadata API
sources.Download Formats: CSV; GeoJSON; GSF; BAG; NetCDF; TIFF; XYZ; native sonar formats
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use DCDB Viewer or CSB Data Extract API for bbox subset; AWS S3 for contributed CSB files; Crowbar for metadata
sources.App Integration Notes: For existence queries, CSB API fields already include lon/lat/depth/time/platform/file identifier.

sources.Observations / Variables: Bathymetric elevation; source-type/TID grid
sources.Platform Types: Gridded synthesis from surveys + inferred sources
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Seafloor static elevation
sources.Time Metadata: No observation time in primary grid
sources.Other Key Metadata: TID/source class; grid version
sources.Native Search / Filters: Spatial subset only; no observation-time query
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Download global/subset grid and TID grid; use as background/static prior rather than raw observation index
sources.App Integration Notes: Do not label GEBCO cells as direct observations; use DCDB for sounding existence and GEBCO for static context.

sources.Operator: GHRSST international project / NASA PO.DAAC + NCEI
sources.Observations / Variables: Sea-surface temperature; uncertainty; quality flags; auxiliary fields
sources.Platform Types: Polar-orbiting and geostationary satellite sensors; blended analyses
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Ocean skin/subskin/foundation SST depending product; surface only
sources.Location Metadata: Per-pixel lat/lon for L2P; grid coordinates for L3/L4
sources.Other Key Metadata: Sensor; platform; processing level L2P/L3/L4; quality level; uncertainty; flags
sources.Native Search / Filters: Discover by product/sensor/time; granule spatial/time through PO.DAAC/Earthdata; L2P is observation-level
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: NASA Earthdata login often required for PO.DAAC downloads
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Search GHRSST/PO.DAAC collections; use Earthdata granule search/OPeNDAP/S3; prefer L2P for actual observations
sources.App Integration Notes: Distinguish L2P observations from L4 analyses in the app UI.

sources.Observations / Variables: SSH/altimetry; SST; sea-surface salinity; winds; waves; currents/topography; gravity; SWOT/CYGNSS and related physical-ocean products
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Mostly surface; mission/product dependent
sources.Depth Metadata: Mostly surface/no vertical; product-specific vertical coordinate if present
sources.Other Key Metadata: Collection/granule IDs; platform; instrument; processing level; version; DOI; quality variables
sources.Native Search / Filters: CMR/Earthdata filters by collection, bbox/polygon, time, platform/instrument; variable subsetting via OPeNDAP for many products
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Earthdata login for protected data access
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use CMR/Earthdata Search to discover collection/granules, then OPeNDAP/direct S3/download links
sources.App Integration Notes: For an existence app, index CMR granule metadata instead of every satellite pixel; fetch pixel data only on drill-down.

sources.Source: NASA Common Metadata Repository (CMR) / Earthdata Search
sources.Observations / Variables: Metadata describing NASA ocean and Earth-observation collections/granules
sources.Platform Types: Satellites and other NASA data holdings
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Metadata-level vertical information varies; mostly not sample depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: Concept ID; short name; version; science keywords; platform; instrument; processing level; provider; service links
sources.QC / Data Mode: Metadata validation by NASA EOSDIS providers
sources.Native Search / Filters: Excellent collection/granule search by spatial/temporal/keyword/platform/instrument/science keyword
sources.Download Formats: JSON; XML; ISO19115; CSV; STAC and other metadata formats
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Search API public; data downloads may require Earthdata login
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use CMR REST/GraphQL API to discover ocean collections/granules; follow service/data links to PO.DAAC/OB.DAAC/etc.
sources.App Integration Notes: Metadata-only but strategically important: one API can power discovery of many NASA satellite sources.

sources.Observations / Variables: SST; sea level/altimetry; waves; ocean color; sea ice; winds and other ocean ECVs depending catalogue
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Mostly surface; some sea-ice/altimetry-derived vertical-like quantities
sources.Other Key Metadata: Product/dataset ID; source missions; processing level; quality flags; uncertainty
sources.Native Search / Filters: Toolbox supports variable/bbox/time and depth when applicable
sources.Download Formats: NetCDF; Zarr; CSV; Parquet depending service
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use catalogue `describe`; use `subset` by variable/bbox/time; use `get` for original files
sources.App Integration Notes: A strong single front door for global satellite ocean products, but retain product provenance.

sources.Observations / Variables: SST; ocean color; SSH; salinity; winds; waves; sea ice and derived fields
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Mostly surface
sources.Other Key Metadata: Dataset ID; source sensor; quality flags; metadata attributes
sources.Native Search / Filters: ERDDAP/THREDDS generally support variable/time/lat/lon subset and dataset search
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use CoastWatch ERDDAP/THREDDS to search datasets and subset; direct file services also available
sources.App Integration Notes: Very developer-friendly operational endpoint; useful complement to PO.DAAC/Copernicus.

sources.Operator: EUMETSAT + Ocean and Sea Ice SAF
sources.Observations / Variables: Ocean surface vector winds; sea ice concentration/type/drift/edge; SST and other marine products depending service
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface / ice surface
sources.Other Key Metadata: Satellite; sensor; product ID; processing chain; quality flags
sources.Native Search / Filters: Catalogue/product-based spatial/time search; APIs/services vary by product
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Free account may be needed for some EUMETSAT data services
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Use EUMETSAT/OSI SAF product catalogue/download services; for app index product metadata and granule footprints/times
sources.App Integration Notes: Important for ASCAT winds and sea ice; source-level queryability is product-specific rather than uniform.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Mission-dependent; SeaWiFS era onward plus current MODIS/VIIRS/PACE
sources.Observations / Variables: Remote sensing reflectance; chlorophyll; pigments; inherent/apparent optical products; productivity and other ocean-color products
sources.Platform Types: SeaWiFS; MODIS; VIIRS; PACE and related missions
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface/upper optical ocean; satellite retrieval, not water-column profile
sources.Other Key Metadata: Mission; sensor; processing level; algorithm/product; version; quality flags
sources.Native Search / Filters: Earthdata/OB.DAAC search by mission/product/time/area; CMR also indexes collections/granules
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Search via Earthdata/OB.DAAC, choose mission/product/time/area, download granules or use cloud access where offered
sources.App Integration Notes: Pair with SeaBASS/AERONET-OC for in-situ validation observations.

sources.Source: SOOP / XBT observations via GTSPP and WOD
sources.Role: Observation network represented through global archives
sources.Observations / Variables: Primarily temperature profiles (XBT); some XCTD T/S; underway T/S on instrumented ships
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface to XBT/XCTD max depth, commonly hundreds to ~1000 m+ depending probe
sources.Depth Metadata: Depth estimated from fall-rate for XBT; pressure/depth for XCTD
sources.Other Key Metadata: Ship/platform; cruise; probe type; recorder/launcher metadata; correction fields
sources.QC / Data Mode: Operational + archive QC; XBT bias corrections important
sources.Native Search / Filters: Use WOD or GTSPP filters for dataset/instrument type, bbox, date, platform
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Search WOD dataset=XBT or GTSPP data type; download profiles; enrich platform metadata from OceanOPS SOOP metadata
sources.App Integration Notes: Model as a network/source lineage, while data access occurs via WOD/GTSPP.

sources.Repository / Network Period: Historical archive 1662-present via ICOADS; operational current via WIS2
sources.Observations / Variables: Wind; pressure; air temperature/humidity; SST; waves; weather/visibility/clouds
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Surface/near-surface; sensor height metadata varies
sources.Other Key Metadata: Ship/call sign/platform type; observing method; source/deck; WIGOS/WMO identifiers where available
sources.Native Search / Filters: Operational discovery via WIS2; historical bulk via ICOADS; app builds own spatial/time index
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Core WIS2 data open; historical archive open
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Subscribe/search WIS2 for current SHIP data; ingest ICOADS daily/monthly files for historical records
sources.App Integration Notes: Model observations by report, not by ship voyage only.

sources.Operator: NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center
sources.Spatial Coverage: Polar/global depending product; marine use primarily Arctic/Antarctic sea ice
sources.Observations / Variables: Sea-ice freeboard, sea-ice thickness, sea-ice elevation, snow depth/density, sea-ice concentration and related cryosphere products
sources.Depth / Vertical Coverage: Sea-ice surface/freeboard/thickness; not a water-column depth profile
sources.Location Metadata: Dataset/granule spatial coverage, projected grids, along-track geolocation
sources.Time Metadata: Dataset/granule temporal coverage and acquisition time
sources.Depth Metadata: Freeboard/thickness/elevation definitions; vertical reference is sea surface/ice geometry rather than water depth
sources.Other Key Metadata: Dataset ID/version, platform, sensor, processing level, spatial/temporal resolution, quality fields, DOI
sources.Native Search / Filters: NSIDC Data Access Tool and NASA Earthdata/CMR provide spatial and temporal filtering
sources.Authentication / Restrictions: Free NASA Earthdata Login required for many downloads
sources.Recommended Download / Access Method: Discover dataset/granules through NSIDC/Earthdata; filter by space/time; use Earthdata cloud/direct download for files
sources.App Integration Notes: Add as a first-class cryosphere connector. Index dataset/granule footprints and processing level; do not treat Level-4 thickness analyses as raw direct measurements.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Argo Core; CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; Deep Argo; GLODAPv3; GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Temperature-Salinity Profile Programme (GTSPP); IOOS National Glider DAC; MEOP-CTD / MEOP-SMS / MEOP-TDR; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); SOOP / XBT observations via GTSPP and WOD; SeaBASS; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Temperature of seawater measured in situ at the observation's stated vertical level. This is a water-column quantity and should be used with depth or pressure metadata.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; GHRSST; GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Drifter Program (GDP); ICOADS; International Arctic Buoy Programme (IABP); International Programme for Antarctic Buoys (IPAB); NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); SOCAT; SeaBASS; Voluntary Observing Ships (VOS) via WIS2/ICOADS
parameter_audit.definition: Temperature assigned to the ocean surface or near-surface layer. The exact physical layer depends on the observing method; preserve the SST subtype or measurement depth whenever it is known.
Temperature of the conductive skin layer at the air-sea interface, approximately the upper tens of micrometres and typically measured by infrared radiometry.
Temperature at the base of the conductive laminar sub-layer immediately below the ocean skin; microwave radiometers approximately sense this layer.
Near-surface temperature representative of water below the diurnal warm layer and therefore minimally affected by the daily surface heating cycle.
Temperature a seawater parcel would have after being moved adiabatically to a specified reference pressure, usually the sea surface.
TEOS-10 temperature variable designed to represent seawater heat content more accurately than potential temperature.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Argo Core; CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; Deep Argo; GLODAPv3; GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Temperature-Salinity Profile Programme (GTSPP); IOOS National Glider DAC; MEOP-CTD / MEOP-SMS / MEOP-TDR; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); SOCAT; SeaBASS; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Practical Salinity Scale 1978 (PSS-78) salinity derived from conductivity ratio; dimensionless although often displayed as PSU.
TEOS-10 mass fraction of dissolved material in seawater, expressed as grams of solute per kilogram of seawater.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; NASA PO.DAAC
parameter_audit.definition: Salinity of the ocean's near-surface layer. Preserve whether it is in-situ practical salinity or a satellite retrieval and its effective sampling depth.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Argo Core; CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; Deep Argo; GLODAPv3; IOOS National Glider DAC; MEOP-CTD / MEOP-SMS / MEOP-TDR; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Pressure exerted by seawater at the observation level, normally reported relative to atmospheric pressure. Ocean profiles commonly use decibars.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Global Temperature-Salinity Profile Programme (GTSPP); IOOS National Glider DAC; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); OBIS; PANGAEA; SOCAT; SeaBASS
parameter_audit.definition: Vertical distance of the observation below the sea surface. It describes where the sample or measurement was taken, not the bottom depth.
Vertical distance from the sea surface or reference datum to the seafloor at the observation location.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: IHO Data Centre for Digital Bathymetry (DCDB)
parameter_audit.definition: Depth to the seafloor measured by a sounding system such as single-beam, multibeam, or crowdsourced echo sounding.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); SeaBASS
parameter_audit.definition: Electrical conductivity of seawater, used with temperature and pressure to derive practical salinity.
Mass per unit volume of seawater at the observed temperature, salinity, and pressure.
Density a seawater parcel would have if moved adiabatically to a specified reference pressure.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: BGC-Argo; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)
parameter_audit.definition: Measure of water cloudiness or light scattering caused by suspended particles; values depend strongly on the instrument and calibration.
Loss of a collimated light beam through water due to absorption and scattering. May be reported as beam attenuation coefficient or transmissivity.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Drifter Program (GDP); IOOS National Glider DAC
parameter_audit.definition: Eastward component of seawater velocity; positive values indicate motion toward the east.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Drifter Program (GDP); IOOS National Glider DAC
parameter_audit.definition: Northward component of seawater velocity; positive values indicate motion toward the north.
Magnitude of the horizontal seawater velocity vector at the stated depth.
Direction toward which the ocean current is flowing, measured clockwise from true north unless the source states otherwise.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; ICOADS; NASA PO.DAAC; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); PANGAEA; Voluntary Observing Ships (VOS) via WIS2/ICOADS
parameter_audit.definition: Magnitude of horizontal wind velocity. Preserve measurement height or whether the value has been converted to an equivalent 10-m neutral wind.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; ICOADS; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); PANGAEA
parameter_audit.definition: Direction from which the wind is blowing, measured clockwise from true north.
Peak short-duration wind speed observed during the reporting interval.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; Global Drifter Program (GDP); ICOADS; International Arctic Buoy Programme (IABP); International Programme for Antarctic Buoys (IPAB); NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); SOCAT
parameter_audit.definition: Atmospheric pressure reduced to mean sea level or a barometric pressure observation used as the marine surface pressure measurement.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GTMBA: TAO/TRITON + PIRATA + RAMA; ICOADS; International Arctic Buoy Programme (IABP); International Programme for Antarctic Buoys (IPAB); NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); PANGAEA
parameter_audit.definition: Temperature of the air at the sensor height above the ocean or platform.

Wave period at the peak of the wave energy spectrum.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)
parameter_audit.definition: Mean direction from which wave energy propagates, normally measured clockwise from true north.

parameter_audit.definition: Significant wave height of the wind-sea partition generated by local winds.

parameter_audit.definition: Direction from which the wind-wave partition propagates.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)
parameter_audit.definition: Significant wave height of the primary swell partition, generally the swell partition with the greatest energy.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; ICOADS; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)
parameter_audit.definition: Representative period of the primary swell partition.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; ICOADS; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC)
parameter_audit.definition: Direction from which the primary swell partition propagates.

parameter_audit.definition: Direction from which the secondary swell partition propagates.

Largest crest elevation above the mean water level during the observation or analysis interval.

Northward component of the wave-induced Stokes drift velocity at the ocean surface.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: GLOSS / IOC Sea Level Monitoring; PSMSL; UHSLC / JASL
parameter_audit.definition: Sea-surface elevation measured relative to a local tide-gauge or station datum. Values from different stations are not directly comparable without datum information.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; NASA PO.DAAC
parameter_audit.definition: Height of the sea surface relative to a geodetic reference surface. In satellite altimetry it is commonly relative to a reference ellipsoid; model products may use a geoid-based reference.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Copernicus Marine satellite observations; NASA PO.DAAC
parameter_audit.definition: Variable component of sea-surface height relative to a mean sea surface or other specified mean reference field.
Sea-surface height relative to the geoid, representing the sum of mean dynamic topography and sea-level anomaly.
Time-mean sea-surface height above the geoid associated with the mean ocean circulation.
Time-averaged sea-surface height relative to the reference ellipsoid, usually derived from long altimeter records.
Water-column height inferred from bottom pressure by a DART/tsunameter system; used to detect tsunami-related sea-level changes.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: BGC-Argo; CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; Copernicus Marine satellite observations; GLODAPv3; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Amount of molecular oxygen dissolved in seawater, expressed as concentration per mass or volume of seawater.

parameter_audit.definition: Concentration of nitrate (NO3−) in seawater.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; Copernicus Marine satellite observations; GLODAPv3; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Concentration of dissolved phosphate in seawater.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: BGC-Argo; CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; GLODAPv3; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Measure of hydrogen-ion activity on a specified pH scale. pH values are only comparable when the scale, temperature and pressure/reference conditions are retained.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; GLODAPv3; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Total concentration of dissolved inorganic carbon species in seawater: dissolved CO2, bicarbonate, and carbonate.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: CCHDO / GO-SHIP hydrography; GLODAPv3; World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Acid-neutralizing capacity of seawater, commonly expressed as micromoles of charge per kilogram.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: BGC-Argo; Copernicus Marine satellite observations; GLODAPv3; NASA Ocean Biology DAAC (OB.DAAC) / OceanColor; NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC); World Ocean Database (WOD)
parameter_audit.definition: Concentration of chlorophyll-a pigment in water, measured directly or estimated from calibrated optical/satellite algorithms.
Optical fluorescence signal associated with chlorophyll. It is a sensor signal or derived estimate and is not automatically equivalent to pigment concentration.
Fluorescence signal from coloured dissolved organic matter (CDOM), used as an optical proxy for dissolved organic material.
Backscattering coefficient due to particles in seawater at a stated wavelength.
Total optical backscattering coefficient of seawater, including water and particulate contributions.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: AERONET-OC; NASA Ocean Biology DAAC (OB.DAAC) / OceanColor; SeaBASS
parameter_audit.definition: Ratio of water-leaving radiance to downwelling irradiance just above the water surface at a specified wavelength.
Radiant flux incident on a horizontal surface from the upper hemisphere at a specified wavelength.
Photon irradiance integrated over the photosynthetically active spectral range, approximately 400–700 nm.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: NASA Ocean Biology DAAC (OB.DAAC) / OceanColor; SeaBASS
parameter_audit.definition: Exponential attenuation rate of downwelling irradiance with depth, usually specified for a wavelength or for PAR.
Mass concentration of suspended particulate material in water.

parameter_audit.supporting_sources: Continuous Plankton Recorder (CPR) Survey; OBIS; OBIS-SEAMAP
parameter_audit.definition: A documented observation or sampling record indicating that a taxon was detected or evaluated at a place and time.

Amount of organisms represented by a record using a stated quantity type, such as count, percent cover, biomass, or concentration.
Mass of biological material for a taxon, community, or sample, normalized by area, volume, or sample as documented.
Statement of whether a taxon was detected (present) or not detected (absent) in a sampling event.
Fraction or percentage of a grid cell or observed area covered by sea ice.
Categorical classification describing open water, open ice, closed ice, or an ice-edge state according to the product definition.
Categorical classification of ice age/type, commonly first-year ice versus multiyear ice.
Eastward component of sea-ice displacement or drift velocity over a stated time interval.
Northward component of sea-ice displacement or drift velocity over a stated time interval.
Vertical thickness of the sea-ice layer, with product-specific definition for whether open water is included in area averaging.
Height of the ice or snow-ice interface above the local sea surface, depending on the retrieval definition.
